input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: An undocumented argument returns `(metavar, None)` instead of `(metavar, "")`. Normalize missing help text to an empty string.
- rationale: When a command has both a documented argument and an argument whose help is unset, the documented argument enables the positional-arguments section. The undocumented argument's record now passes None to the help formatter, which expects string descriptions, causing help generation to crash instead of displaying an empty description. The previous fallback supplied an empty string.
critique: The finding points at the same fault: get_help_record returns None as the help element for an undocumented argument. It also describes the same failure, where the formatter receives None and help generation crashes when one argument is documented and another is not. Normalizing to an empty string is the same fix.
